data.additional_information:
Job Description: Business Incubation Strategy Intern
Business Unit: Business Incubation
Location: Bangalore
Duration: 12-16 weeks / 3-4 Months
Reporting To: Head of Business Incubation
Preferred Background: MBA / management student from a leading institution
Role: Type Internship
Focus: Startup ecosystem mapping, strategy, and technology commercialization
About the Role:
Fujitsu Research India is looking for a Business Incubation Strategy Intern to support a strategic function focused on startup collaboration, ecosystem engagement, and technology commercialization in India.
The intern will help map India’s startup and innovation ecosystem, identify relevant incubators and ecosystem partners, create short-term and long-term engagement plans, and support strategic initiatives that connect emerging startups with advanced technology and business opportunities.
This role is ideal for someone passionate about startups, entrepreneurship, innovation, and the future of technology-led business creation. Candidates with an entrepreneurial mindset, including those aspiring to build their own startup in the future, may be a strong fit.
Why This Role Is Exciting:
• Work at the intersection of startups, strategy, emerging technologies, and corporate innovation.
• Gain practical exposure to how large technology organizations engage with startup and incubation ecosystems.
• Contribute to real ecosystem mapping, partner prioritization, and business incubation planning.
• Support leadership-level reports and recommendations for startup and ecosystem engagement in India.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Startup and Incubator Ecosystem Mapping
• Map key incubators, accelerators, academic innovation centers, entrepreneurship cells, government-supported startup programs, and industry-led startup platforms across India.
• Identify relevant ecosystem partners across major startup hubs such as Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Ahmedabad, and other emerging innovation clusters.
• Categorize partners by domain focus, startup maturity, geography, reputation, accessibility, and strategic relevance.

2. Partner and People Mapping
• Identify key decision-makers, program heads, startup leads, partnership contacts, and ecosystem stakeholders in priority institutions.
• Create a structured database of relevant organizations, contacts, and engagement notes.
• Support preparation of outreach lists for short-term and long-term engagement.

3. Startup and Technology Relevance Analysis
• Identify incubators and startup programs working in areas relevant to Fujitsu’s focus areas, such as AI, quantum, deeptech, enterprise technology, sustainability, manufacturing, digital transformation, and emerging technologies.
• Prepare short profiles of priority incubators, accelerators, and ecosystem partners.
• Highlight potential collaboration areas between startups, ecosystem partners, and Fujitsu technologies.

4. Short-Term and Long-Term Engagement Planning
• Create a short-term partner list for engagement over the next 3-6 months.
• Create a long-term strategic partner list for engagement over the next 6-18 months.
• Recommend suitable engagement formats such as startup roundtables, technology open house sessions, curated startup meetings, event participation, sponsorship opportunities, pilot discussions, or co-creation programs.

5. Prioritization Framework
• Develop a practical scoring framework to prioritize incubators, startups, and ecosystem partners.
• Assess partners based on startup quality, technology relevance, corporate collaboration readiness, access feasibility, geographic relevance, government/industry linkage, and strategic value.
• Support preparation of management-ready summaries and recommendations.

6. Event and Visibility Mapping
• Identify relevant startup, deeptech, AI, quantum, innovation, and industry events in India.
• Assess events based on relevance, audience quality, speaking opportunity, startup access, partner engagement potential, and visibility value.
• Recommend events where Fujitsu may consider participation, speaking opportunities, roundtable engagement, or selective sponsorship.

7. Reporting and Presentation Support
• Prepare structured reports, dashboards, Excel trackers, partner maps, and presentation material.
• Support leadership discussions by creating concise analysis notes and recommendation documents.
• Track progress across ecosystem mapping, partner prioritization, and startup engagement activities.

Expected Deliverables:
• India startup and incubator ecosystem map
• Priority incubator and ecosystem partner database
• Top priority incubators / ecosystem partners
• Top short-term engagement targets
• Top long-term strategic partners
• People and contact mapping for priority institutions
• Partner prioritization framework
• Event and sponsorship opportunity map
• Recommended engagement models
• Final management-ready report and presentation

Ideal Candidate Profile:
• Strong interest in startups, entrepreneurship, innovation, and business incubation.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and curiosity to understand how startups are built, supported, scaled, and commercialized.
• Ability to conduct structured research and convert information into actionable insights.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business research skills.
• Good communication, writing, and presentation skills.
• Ability to prepare clear PowerPoint presentations, Excel trackers, and concise business reports.
• Interest in emerging technologies such as AI, quantum, deeptech, enterprise technology, sustainability, and digital transformation.
• Self-driven working style with attention to detail and ownership mindset.
• Professional maturity to interact with internal teams and external ecosystem stakeholders.
Preferred Background:
• MBA / management student from a leading institution.
• Exposure to strategy, entrepreneurship, innovation, technology management, business development, or startup ecosystem work will be preferred.
• Prior experience with startups, entrepreneurship cells, incubation centers, consulting projects, venture capital, market research, technology commercialization, or ecosystem mapping will be an advantage.
• Candidates who have worked on startup ideas, student ventures, business plans, pitch decks, founder-led projects, or innovation competitions will be strongly preferred.

What the Intern Will Gain:
• Exposure to corporate-startup collaboration and business incubation strategy.
• Hands-on experience in startup and incubator ecosystem mapping.
• Understanding of technology commercialization and strategic partnership development.
• Opportunity to work on deeptech and emerging technology ecosystem opportunities.
• Experience in leadership-level business reporting and real-world innovation ecosystem building.
